items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: Charlie, you worked with him, didn't you?

ctx.x: It's a pretty strange one. And by the way,

Yeah. By the way, Joe Burton, even though he wasn't a great player, was responsible for getting some of the best bass players and drummers work in town. Reed worked with him quite a while. James Black worked with him quite a while. Charlie, you worked with him, didn't you?
